description: §13.2 + §19.4.3 — the SUCCESS path of a cell-assigned failable server call: `@out = risky(3) !{ … }` then `` @seen = `loaded:${@out}` ``. The stub answers 9, so after the #load click and a settle @out is 9 and the statement after the handler reads the RESOLVED cell (`loaded:9`). The pre-fix emit fired the call + handler as a detached IIFE, so `@seen` read the stale initial 0 (`loaded:0`) — the flogenceP `needsAttention` header bug (g-failable-cell-load-fire-and-forget-stale-read-dead-return).
rationale: §13.2 SHALL insert `await` at every server call site and sequence dependent operations. The read of @out after the guarded write depends on it, so it must observe the resolved success value. S478 (bootstrap triage C12): SPEC §19.9.10 (S451/S454): "A call made on the client whose callee is server-placed is a **failable call** at that site, whether or not the callee is declared `!`. It SHALL be handled exactly as a call to a `!` function (§19.4.3) … An unhandled one SHALL be **E-ERROR-002**"; its failure set is "`f`'s declared variants plus ONE wrapper variant `Transport(t: ServerCallError)`; a non-`!` callee fails with `Transport` alone" (S454 F1). The handler now covers `.Transport`.
